items: One day of MomX history is capped at 400 rows per page - 2,509 rows in one 5 MB payload was freezing the phone; older rows are behind the pager.
History and board responses are compressed end to end, so a page that shipped 4.5 MB now ships a fraction of that.
Each board list warms on its own thread, so a slow Watchlist build no longer delays the others; the heavy builds are still limited to one at a time so charts keep their CPU.
A typo in a config value could take the whole app down on start - it now fails safe. The 09:00 morning brief is pushed to your phone.

releases.heading: Momentum alerts can finally fire, plus premarket and gate fixes
releases.subheading: Pre-open deploy
items: MomX momentum alerts had never fired: the live candle carried about 2% of the real volume (IEX feed), so RVOL could not reach the threshold. Live-tail volume now comes from Schwab.
The 4h volume gate and the close gate both read the live candle now - AAPL was being blocked at +1.49% because the gate could not see the opening move.
Premarket: the table's Date/Time was the signal's bar time and is now labelled as such; a window that healed no longer keeps saying 'premarket unavailable'.
MomX history is sortable, shows how much a cell moved by, and has a live Time column. Admins get a Preflight health checklist that measures each dependency instead of asserting it is fine.

releases.heading: Scanner is now Premarket, and two scroll traps are gone
releases.subheading: Both found on the phone, both fixed at the cause
items: The Scanner tab is renamed Premarket, with a sunrise icon. MomX is also a scanner, so two tabs both called scanner told you nothing about which was which - now they name the two halves of the day, before the bell and during it. Everything inside the page is unchanged.

MomX History would not scroll left or right. The history view wrapped everything in one box, and the panel treats any such box like a toolbar - pinning it and capping its width - so the table inside had nowhere to move. Removing the box lets the same rules that scroll the live board handle history too.

Premarket would not scroll up. The Columns picker carried a rule meant for floating menus - do not let scrolling here move the page behind - but that picker sits inline in the page, so any swipe starting inside it was dead: neither the picker nor the page moved. It now scrolls its own list first and hands the swipe to the page at the end.

A quiet day in MomX History clipped its own message mid-word on the phone until you panned right. The sentence now stays readable wherever you scroll. The live board had the same hidden flaw and got the same fix.

releases.heading: History could show tickers the scan never matched - fixed same hour
releases.subheading: If you saw JD or BILI in Mag7 History tonight, this is why
items: The test suite was accidentally writing its practice data into the real history archive - five made-up rows appeared under Mag7 History minutes after the feature shipped. Caught by checking the live archive instead of trusting passing tests. The fake rows are deleted, real data was kept, and the suite is now walled off from the real archive in a way that survives the trap that beat the first fix.

releases.heading: Scanner History - 30 days of what the scan matched, and when
releases.subheading: Two new tabs, plus a Send test button for phone alerts
items: MomX has two new tabs: Mag7 History and Watchlist History. Every ticker that passes the scan is archived - one row for the moment it arrived (marked NEW, with the time) and another row each time a signal column visibly changes: RVOL, squeeze, Skittles, H/L, colours, news. The changed cells are highlighted, so reading down a ticker's rows tells you what moved and when.
Search a ticker to see every day it fired across the last 30 days, with times. Duplicate rows are deliberate - they ARE the story of the move.

Days navigate with the same left/right control as the premarket history. A day where nothing matched shows as an archived quiet day, not a gap. History starts recording from tonight; days before it existed cannot be backfilled.

Phone alerts: a Send test button now sits next to Generate in the Momo settings. Press it and your phone should buzz within seconds - green means the push definitely left the server, red tells you what to fix. No more finishing setup and just hoping.
Setup instructions gained the matching step 4: press Send test, your phone buzzes, and if not the topic names do not match - they are case-sensitive.

releases.heading: Scanner charts: the whole board, not the top 12
releases.subheading: DG was row 15 and fell outside the window
items: The chart pre-loader now covers all 59 rows on your board instead of the first 12. Measured just before this change: 25 of 57 board tickers held today's candles and 32 still ended on Friday - including DG, PANW, SNOW, MDB and MU, all visible on your board at the time.

This costs nothing extra. The limit that bounds the work is refreshes-per-minute, not how many tickers are watched, so covering 59 spreads the same two refreshes a minute wider rather than adding load.

The trade-off, stated plainly: 59 tickers at two a minute is a ~28 minute sweep, so a ticker can be up to ~28 minutes stale instead of ~11. Against the 80 hours measured today, that is the right side of it.
All 32 stale tickers were also caught up by hand tonight, so tomorrow's premarket does not start from Friday.
The server also stopped erasing its own log on every restart. That erasure destroyed the evidence needed to answer whether this morning's speed fix worked.

releases.heading: Scanner tickers are pre-loaded before you click them
releases.subheading: Plus this page, and private saved grids
items: A background helper reads the same scanner board you are looking at and brings those charts up to date in advance. It starts at 3:30 AM so the board is ready before premarket, and re-checks through the day. Cost: 12 milliseconds a minute.
To switch it off without a developer: create an empty file named prewarm_paused in the artifacts folder. It stops within a minute, no restart needed.
This page. Release notes now live in the app, one entry per deploy, so when something starts behaving differently you can see exactly what shipped and when.

Saved chart grids are private per account. They used to live in one shared file with no owner, so one person could see another's layouts - and worse, saving a grid overwrote the file and deleted everyone else's.

releases.heading: Charts stopped serving stale candles
releases.subheading: The frozen tape, and 47% of the server spent recomputing nothing
items: The big one. A chart could show candles over two hours old while the broker had 40-second-old bars for the same ticker - GME was measured 151 minutes behind. Two different jobs inside the server shared one 'busy' flag, so any ticker with a slow rebuild queued had every quick top-up thrown away for the whole wait. The refresh button died at the same place, which is why pressing it never helped.

Verified after the fix, during market hours: five stale tickers went from 43-76 minutes behind to under 3 minutes. Refresh now genuinely fetches - one ticker went from 76 minutes stale to current in the same click.

Charts are faster to build. The indicator stack was being recalculated nine times per ticker every 30 seconds - 47% of the entire server's work - for an answer that cannot change between two one-minute candles. It now recalculates only when a candle actually closes.
A stale chart now appears in about a quarter of a second and is fully current about five seconds later. Before today that was 40 to 200 seconds.

releases.heading: Chart controls, option chain and the scanner board
releases.subheading: The morning's fixes, no restart needed
items: The left/right time scrubber under the chart is visible again. It had been rendering BELOW the visible area and getting clipped away - which is why no colour change ever helped, and why it showed on the phone but not the desktop.
The chart fills its panel again. Capping its height to keep the scrubber on screen left a black gap underneath on some window sizes; it now sizes to the space it is given.
New pan arrows in the chart toolbar. One click moves a third of a screen through time, hold to travel faster. They move time only - your price scale and levels stay put.

Option chain: the Vol column was blank on every strike. The gateway was serving a snapshot taken at 9:15 AM - before the bell, when nothing had traded - and it had no expiry rule at all, so it served that same pre-open chain all session. Chain data now expires after 30 seconds.
Option chain: added Delta, Volume and Mark columns to the High OI board, matching MomoX. Put deltas now show their minus sign.

Scanner: one slow build used to freeze the board for as long as the build took - a 22-minute build meant 22 minutes of stale data, which is why the board sat on 10:30 data at 11:00. That rest period is now capped at 2 minutes.

Scanner: the data-age note is always visible, not only when data is stale. UPDATED tells you when the scan ran; the new note tells you how old the BARS are - that second number is what decides whether a signal is tradeable.
Phone: the chart could not be panned back, because scroll rules written for the scanner table had leaked into the chart tab.

releases.heading: Momo Alert, news badges and first-time setup
releases.subheading: The DKNG signature, on your phone
items: Momo Alert: an app-wide alarm for the DKNG signature - a volume surge on an armed timeframe while the momentum scan passes. Banner, sound, and a push to your phone through ntfy, so it reaches you with the browser closed and the phone locked.
Momo Alert settings are per account: your timeframes, thresholds, sound and phone channel are yours alone and cannot be changed by another user.
Phone pushes for the Momo Alert are limited to 9:15 AM - 3:30 PM ET, so overnight and premarket noise stays silent. The in-app banner still works at any hour.
Morning brief and MAG7 scanner signals also push to your phone; MAG7 pushes only start at 9:00 AM.
Scanner rows show a news badge when a ticker has a headline from the last 24 hours. Tap it for the headline, its age, and a link. Volume with news is a catalyst move; volume without one is flow.
Scanner rows show when a ticker entered the matched set - NEW for the first 15 minutes, then the time it arrived. This survives restarts, so you can always tell a fresh match from a holdover.
The scanner re-runs continuously (about every 15-35 seconds) instead of once a minute, and the refresh button now genuinely re-runs the scan.
Learn + Setup: first-time setup steps written to be followed without a developer, with annotated photographs.

releases.heading: Backups and disaster recovery
releases.subheading: What happens if this laptop dies
items: Nightly backup of the trade journal, your keys and the entire codebase to Google Drive, twice a day - after the close and overnight. The journal is copied with a method that cannot capture a half-written database.
The Cloudflare tunnel credentials are included, so a rebuilt machine can serve app.agxtrade.com again without manual setup.
A runbook lives in the project (docs/RUNBOOK.md): how the app starts itself, what each symptom means, the weekly Schwab re-connect, and how to rebuild everything on a new laptop.
